summary: Depth 5 on an NSE equity: a 1502 event (quote in Touchline, five bids and asks) becomes a Depth frame with the five-level book; a later 1502 with empty Bids and Asks clears every level.

notes: XTS 1502 carries no OpenInterest for an equity; both sides send OI 0 in the Depth frame.

deviations.reason: XTS sent average_price in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode.

XTS sent last_quantity in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode.
An XTS 1502 event carries no LowerCircuitLimit; the web sends lower_circuit 0 for it (message.get('LowerCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).

This web adapter puts the mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's entry in lane wire's per-broker dialect switch.

This web adapter sends OI as oi only; the desktop sends open_interest beside it. open_interest follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's dialect entry.

XTS sent total_buy_quantity in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode.

XTS sent total_sell_quantity in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode.
An XTS 1502 event carries no UpperCircuitLimit; the web sends upper_circuit 0 for it (message.get('UpperCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.
